\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 149-152 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R157-first-pass-words-from-chapters-149-152}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a port and a chimney.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to waste, to economise, to divide, to compare, to expect
  \item the body, a heel, the throat, a wound, a pill
  \item a blister, a pimple, an ointment, a drop, a capsule
  \item this year, daily, monthly, last, after
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To waste? (\textbf{\fa{هدر} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{hadar dâdan}.) To economise? (\textbf{\fa{صرفه} \fa{جویی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{sarfejuyi kardan}.) To divide? (\textbf{\fa{تقسیم} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{taqsim kardan}.) To compare? (\textbf{\fa{مقایسه} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{moqâyese kardan}.) To expect? (\textbf{\fa{انتظار} \fa{داشتن}}, \emph{entezâr dâshtan}.) The body? (\textbf{\fa{بدن}}, \emph{badan}.) A heel? (\textbf{\fa{پاشنه}}, \emph{pâshne}.) The throat? (\textbf{\fa{گلو}}, \emph{galu}.) A wound? (\textbf{\fa{زخم}}, \emph{zakhm}.) A pill? (\textbf{\fa{قرص}}, \emph{qors}.) A blister? (\textbf{\fa{تاول}}, \emph{tâval}.) A pimple? (\textbf{\fa{جوش}}, \emph{jush}.) An ointment? (\textbf{\fa{پماد}}, \emph{pomâd}.) A drop? (\textbf{\fa{قطره}}, \emph{qatre}.) A capsule? (\textbf{\fa{کپسول}}, \emph{kapsul}.) This year? (\textbf{\fa{امسال}}, \emph{emsâl}.) Daily? (\textbf{\fa{روزانه}}, \emph{ruzâne}.) Monthly? (\textbf{\fa{ماهانه}}, \emph{mâhâne}.) Last? (\textbf{\fa{آخر}}, \emph{âkhar}.) After? (\textbf{\fa{پس} \fa{از}}, \emph{pas az}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 153-157 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R157-second-pass-words-from-chapters-153-157}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for midnight and ago.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item midnight, ago, then, finally, weekly
  \item a store, a supermarket, a butcher's shop, a café, a doctor's surgery
  \item a secondary school, a police station, the town hall, an embassy, customs
  \item a well, a hut, a mill, an underground water channel, a small shop
  \item a dead end, a dormitory, a prison, a port, a chimney
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Midnight? (\textbf{\fa{نیمه} \fa{شب}}, \emph{nime-shab}.) Ago? (\textbf{\fa{پیش}}, \emph{pish}.) Then? (\textbf{\fa{سپس}}, \emph{sepas}.) Finally? (\textbf{\fa{بالاخره}}, \emph{bâlâkhare}.) Weekly? (\textbf{\fa{هفتگی}}, \emph{haftegi}.) A store? (\textbf{\fa{فروشگاه}}, \emph{forushgâh}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{\fa{سوپرمارکت}}, \emph{supermârket}.) A butcher's shop? (\textbf{\fa{قصابی}}, \emph{qassâbi}.) A café? (\textbf{\fa{کافه}}, \emph{kâfe}.) A doctor's surgery? (\textbf{\fa{مطب}}, \emph{matab}.) A secondary school? (\textbf{\fa{دبیرستان}}, \emph{dabirestân}.) A police station? (\textbf{\fa{کلانتری}}, \emph{kalântari}.) The town hall? (\textbf{\fa{شهرداری}}, \emph{shahrdâri}.) An embassy? (\textbf{\fa{سفارت}}, \emph{sefârat}.) Customs? (\textbf{\fa{گمرک}}, \emph{gomrok}.) A well? (\textbf{\fa{چاه}}, \emph{châh}.) A hut? (\textbf{\fa{کلبه}}, \emph{kolbe}.) A mill? (\textbf{\fa{آسیاب}}, \emph{âsiyâb}.) An underground water channel? (\textbf{\fa{قنات}}, \emph{qanât}.) A small shop? (\textbf{\fa{دکان}}, \emph{dokkân}.) A dead end? (\textbf{\fa{بنبست}}, \emph{bonbast}.) A dormitory? (\textbf{\fa{خوابگاه}}, \emph{khâbgâh}.) A prison? (\textbf{\fa{زندان}}, \emph{zendân}.) A port? (\textbf{\fa{بندر}}, \emph{bandar}.) A chimney? (\textbf{\fa{دودکش}}, \emph{dudkesh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
